title: RCT-Reviewer: A Modernized, Standalone Tool for Automated Analysis of Clinical Trials (RCTs)
description: RCT-Reviewer is a modernized, standalone successor to the acclaimed RobotReviewer, designed to automate the assessment of Clinical Trials (RCTs). It leverages advanced machine learning techniques, including Support Verctor Machines (SVMs), to provide a comprehensive evaluation of RCTs, focusing on risk of bias and other critical factors that influence the reliability of trial outcomes. The tool is built using Python and Streamlit, ensuring a user-friendly interface for researchers and clinicians. RCT-Reviewer aims to streamline the systematic review process, enabling faster and more accurate synthesis of evidence-based medicine.
